title: A chat turn is undone only when it is safe: the server refuses with the reason when content changed after it, files moved, a restore happened, a turn is open, the seat lacks the toolset, the change is shared, or the site runs EmDash; otherwise it undoes files then content, newest first, and stops at the first step that did not verifiably succeed
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'content changed after the turn in the CMS admin blocks it; a cron row does not' passes.
'files changed after: the host preflight conflict blocks that turn and every older one' passes.
'a restore after the turn blocks it, unless it is the undo of a turn of the run' passes.
'a turn open on the site blocks every turn, and outranks every other reason' passes.
'a missing toolset blocks with the toolset named; going back needs every toolset of the run' passes.
'latest vs from-here: the newest turn that changed something is latest, older ones go back to here' passes.
'runUndo: in order, files before content, and it stops at the first step that did not succeed' passes.
'revertOutcome: only ok:true is a revert; a clean no is failed; silence is unsure' and 'fileOutcome: a verified restore commit is undone; a refusal failed; anything that may have run unsure' pass.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/sites/turn-undo.js turnsView, undoPlan, runUndo, revertOutcome, fileOutcome

evidence: Measured 05/10/2026 on cowork.tracy.site: undo lived only in Site changes, undid files but not content, and was refused when a later turn touched the same files. WordPress content.replace reverts were measured to overwrite a later edit (tasks/evidence stand-e2e.md:477), so content undo must refuse when anything changed after the turn.
fence: The decision function turnsView (every block reason and its priority), undoPlan (latest vs from-here, newest first) and runUndo (files before content, stop at the first step that did not verifiably succeed). Pure: no Postgres, no host, no site.

tests: content changed after the turn in the CMS admin blocks it
files changed after: the host preflight conflict blocks
a restore after the turn blocks it
a turn open on the site blocks every turn
a missing toolset blocks with the toolset named
runUndo: in order, files before content
revertOutcome: only ok:true is a revert
fileOutcome: a verified restore commit is undone
